<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Gohan''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]]. He teaches ki skills and four ki attacks, and runs the '''Shadow Boxing''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Gohan lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]] with Goku, in a plains biome. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 1 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House#Finding it|Goku's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Gohan needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good). Below that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], Ki Boost, [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Protection|Ki Protection]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Masenko, Special Beam Cannon, Kamehameha, Ki Barrage
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:13-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill.
</translate>

<translate>
== Training == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
Gohan's '''Train''' option offers a Shadow Clone to spar with and the '''Shadow Boxing''' minigame: type the combo of keys shown on screen before the timers run out. Play it from Gohan 3 times reaching level 5 to learn it; after that you can replay it from the Minigames tab of your menu, and starting it from Gohan pays a +25% mentor bonus.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:17-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 36, ''Flying Lessons'': reach Fly level 1 and talk to Gohan.
</translate>

<translate>
== As a tournament fighter == <!--T:19-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:20-->
Gohan also fights in two [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournaments]], as NPC fighters separate from the master:
* '''Teen Gohan (Mid, Super Saiyan)''' is the semi-finalist of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]]. Teen Gohan's base and Super Saiyan 2 forms are in the Cell Games contender pool too, but the semi-finalist takes his place first, so they are never drawn.
* '''Gohan (End)''', in his base, Super Saiyan or Super Saiyan 2 form, and '''Ultimate Gohan (End)''' can be drawn as contenders in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. They count as one character, so a bracket has at most one of them.
</translate>
